subtopic: Section A — Physical-Layer Devices (Hub, Repeater, Modem & Simple Devices)
stem_en: Which device operates only at the Physical layer (Layer 1) of the OSI model?
stem_hi: OSI model की केवल Physical layer (Layer 1) पर कौन-सा device काम करता है?
explanation_en: A hub is a dumb Layer-1 device — it regenerates and forwards bits to ALL ports without reading MAC addresses.
explanation_hi: Hub एक dumb Layer-1 device है — यह bits को regenerate करके सभी ports पर भेजता है, बिना MAC addresses पढ़े।
nukta_en: Layer 1 = Hub, Repeater, Modem, cables. Layer 2 = Switch, Bridge, NIC. Layer 3 = Router. Gateway = all 7 (protocol converter).
nukta_hi: Layer 1 = Hub, Repeater, Modem, cables। Layer 2 = Switch, Bridge, NIC। Layer 3 = Router। Gateway = सभी 7 (protocol converter)।

subtopic: Section A — Physical-Layer Devices (Hub, Repeater, Modem & Simple Devices)
stem_en: Which of the following devices operates only in the physical layer?
stem_hi: निम्न में से कौन-सा device केवल physical layer पर काम करता है?
explanation_en: A repeater works at Layer 1 — it only regenerates (amplifies + reshapes) the signal to extend the cable distance.
explanation_hi: Repeater Layer 1 पर काम करता है — यह केवल signal को regenerate (amplify + reshape) करके cable distance बढ़ाता है।
nukta_en: Repeater = signal regenerator (L1). Hub = multi-port repeater (L1). Both are 'dumb' devices.
nukta_hi: Repeater = signal regenerator (L1)। Hub = multi-port repeater (L1)। दोनों 'dumb' devices हैं।

subtopic: Section A — Physical-Layer Devices (Hub, Repeater, Modem & Simple Devices)
stem_en: Which of the following pairs lists the network devices used at the physical layer?
stem_hi: निम्न में से कौन-सी जोड़ी physical layer पर उपयोग होने वाले network devices बताती है?
explanation_en: Repeater and Hub both work at the physical layer — they regenerate/forward signals without frame intelligence.
explanation_hi: Repeater और Hub दोनों physical layer पर काम करते हैं — ये signals को regenerate/forward करते हैं, बिना frame intelligence के।
nukta_en: Rajasthan PYQ (verified key: D). Physical-layer pair = Repeater + Hub. Switch/Bridge = L2, Gateway = L7.
nukta_hi: Rajasthan PYQ (verified key: D)। Physical-layer जोड़ी = Repeater + Hub। Switch/Bridge = L2, Gateway = L7।

subtopic: Section A — Physical-Layer Devices (Hub, Repeater, Modem & Simple Devices)
stem_en: Which of the following are network connecting devices? 1. Repeater  2. Bridge  3. Hub  4. Bluetooth
stem_hi: निम्न में से कौन network connecting devices हैं? 1. Repeater  2. Bridge  3. Hub  4. Bluetooth
explanation_en: Repeater, Bridge and Hub are all network connecting DEVICES; Bluetooth is a wireless TECHNOLOGY/standard, not a connecting device.
explanation_hi: Repeater, Bridge और Hub — तीनों network connecting DEVICES हैं; Bluetooth एक wireless TECHNOLOGY/standard है, connecting device नहीं।
nukta_en: Devices vs technologies: repeater/bridge/hub/switch/router = devices. Bluetooth/Wi-Fi/Ethernet = technologies/standards.
nukta_hi: Devices बनाम technologies: repeater/bridge/hub/switch/router = devices। Bluetooth/Wi-Fi/Ethernet = technologies/standards।

subtopic: Section A — Physical-Layer Devices (Hub, Repeater, Modem & Simple Devices)
stem_en: Which of the following statements are TRUE? 1. Switch reduces collision domain. 2. Hub creates a separate collision domain for each port. 3. Router separates broadcast domains.
stem_hi: निम्न में से कौन-से कथन सही हैं? 1. Switch collision domain को कम करता है। 2. Hub हर port के लिए अलग collision domain बनाता है। 3. Router broadcast domains को अलग करता है।
explanation_en: Statement 1 is true (each switch port = own collision domain) and 3 is true (router = broadcast-domain boundary). Statement 2 is FALSE — a hub has ONE collision domain for all its ports.
explanation_hi: कथन 1 सही है (हर switch port = अपना collision domain) और 3 सही है (router = broadcast-domain सीमा)। कथन 2 गलत है — hub के सभी ports के लिए एक ही collision domain होता है।
nukta_en: Switch: collision ↓ (per-port). Hub: 1 collision domain. Router: broadcast domains separated. Ye teeno golden statements hain.
nukta_hi: Switch: collision ↓ (per-port)। Hub: 1 collision domain। Router: broadcast domains अलग। ये तीनों golden statements हैं।

subtopic: Section A — Physical-Layer Devices (Hub, Repeater, Modem & Simple Devices)
stem_en: Which device combines transmission from various I/O devices into one line?
stem_hi: कौन-सा device विभिन्न I/O devices के transmission को एक line में मिलाता है?
explanation_en: A multiplexer (MUX) combines several input signals into ONE shared line (FDM/TDM) at the sending end; a demultiplexer separates them again.
explanation_hi: Multiplexer (MUX) भेजने वाली ओर कई input signals को एक shared line में मिलाता है (FDM/TDM); demultiplexer उन्हें फिर अलग करता है।
nukta_en: MUX = many→one line (FDM/TDM/WDM). Concentrator = statistical sharing of a line. Gateway = protocol converter.
nukta_hi: MUX = कई→एक line (FDM/TDM/WDM)। Concentrator = line का statistical sharing। Gateway = protocol converter।

subtopic: Section A — Physical-Layer Devices (Hub, Repeater, Modem & Simple Devices)
stem_en: A file server is a ______ which is used to store files received from various client machines.
stem_hi: File server एक ______ है जिसका उपयोग विभिन्न client machines से प्राप्त files संग्रहित करने के लिए होता है।
explanation_en: A file server is a specialised computer (with large storage) that stores and serves files to clients in a client-server network.
explanation_hi: File server एक विशेष computer (बड़े storage के साथ) है जो client-server network में clients को files संग्रहित करके देता है।
nukta_en: Servers (file/print/mail/web) = specialised computers. Modem = signal converter, Router = packet forwarder, Transponder = satellite relay.
nukta_hi: Servers (file/print/mail/web) = विशेष computers। Modem = signal converter, Router = packet forwarder, Transponder = satellite relay।

subtopic: Section A — Physical-Layer Devices (Hub, Repeater, Modem & Simple Devices)
stem_en: In a data-entry office, computer centres on the 1st and 4th floors are connected by LANs, but signals take time to travel. Which hardware can improve the data transmission?
stem_hi: एक data-entry office में 1वीं और 4वीं मंज़िल के computer centres LAN से जुड़े हैं, पर signals में समय लगता है. बेहतर transmission के लिए कौन-सा hardware लगाएँ?
explanation_en: A repeater regenerates (amplifies and reshapes) the weakening signal — that is why it is what we install for distance problems.
explanation_hi: Repeater कमज़ोर होते signal को दोबारा ताक़तवर बनाता (regenerate करता) है — इसलिए दूरी की समस्या में यही लगता है.
nukta_en: संकेत कमज़ोर → Repeater; रास्ता चाहिए → Router; analog↔digital → Modem.
nukta_hi: संकेत कमज़ोर → Repeater; रास्ता चाहिए → Router; analog↔digital → Modem.

subtopic: Section A — Physical-Layer Devices (Hub, Repeater, Modem & Simple Devices)
stem_en: A device that operates at the physical layer of the OSI model is:
stem_hi: OSI model की physical layer पर काम करने वाला device है:
explanation_en: Repeater physical layer (Layer 1) का device है — यह signal regenerate करता है. Bridge Layer 2, Router Layer 3 पर.
explanation_hi: Repeater physical layer (Layer 1) का device है — यह signal regenerate करता है. Bridge Layer 2, Router Layer 3 पर.
nukta_en: Layer-device जोड़ी: L1 = Repeater/Hub, L2 = Bridge/Switch, L3 = Router, L4+ = Gateway.
nukta_hi: Layer-device जोड़ी: L1 = Repeater/Hub, L2 = Bridge/Switch, L3 = Router, L4+ = Gateway.

subtopic: Section B — Switch / NIC / Bridge
stem_en: Which device reduces collision domains (each port has its own collision domain) but does NOT break broadcast domains?
stem_hi: कौन-सा device collision domains को कम करता है (हर port का अपना collision domain) लेकिन broadcast domains को तोड़ता नहीं?
explanation_en: A switch gives every port a separate collision domain (full-duplex = no collisions) but ALL its ports share ONE broadcast domain (unless VLANs are used).
explanation_hi: Switch हर port को अलग collision domain देता है (full-duplex = कोई collision नहीं) लेकिन सभी ports एक ही broadcast domain share करते हैं (जब तक VLAN न हो)।
nukta_en: Switch = collision domains many, broadcast 1. Router = broadcast domains many. Hub = 1 collision + 1 broadcast. VLAN = splits broadcast on a switch.
nukta_hi: Switch = collision domains कई, broadcast 1। Router = broadcast domains कई। Hub = 1 collision + 1 broadcast। VLAN = switch पर broadcast तोड़ता है।

subtopic: Section B — Switch / NIC / Bridge
stem_en: Which device stores MAC addresses in a CAM table?
stem_hi: कौन-सा device MAC addresses को CAM table में संग्रहित करता है?
explanation_en: A switch learns source MAC addresses and stores them in its CAM (Content Addressable Memory) table to forward frames only to the right port.
explanation_hi: Switch source MAC addresses सीखकर उन्हें अपने CAM (Content Addressable Memory) table में रखता है ताकि frames सही port पर ही भेजे जाएँ।
nukta_en: Switch = MAC table (CAM). Router = routing table (IP). Hub = no table (floods). ARP cache = IP→MAC mapping (host).
nukta_hi: Switch = MAC table (CAM)। Router = routing table (IP)। Hub = कोई table नहीं (floods)। ARP cache = IP→MAC mapping (host)।

subtopic: Section B — Switch / NIC / Bridge
stem_en: A switch receives a frame whose destination MAC is NOT in its MAC table. What does the switch do?
stem_hi: एक switch को frame मिलता है जिसका destination MAC उसके MAC table में नहीं है। Switch क्या करेगा?

options.text_en: Send the frame to the router only
options.text_hi: Send the frame to the router only

options.text_en: Flood the frame out of all its ports (same broadcast domain)
options.text_hi: Flood the frame out of all its ports (same broadcast domain)

options.text_en: Broadcast it on the entire internet
options.text_hi: Broadcast it on the entire internet

explanation_en: On an unknown unicast destination, the switch floods the frame out of every port (except the source port) within the broadcast domain — this is how it learns.
explanation_hi: अज्ञात unicast destination पर switch frame को हर port (source port को छोड़कर) से broadcast domain के भीतर flood करता है — इसी तरह वह सीखता है।
nukta_en: Unknown unicast → flood. Known unicast → single port. Broadcast FF:FF:... → flood. Source MAC → learn/refresh in CAM.
nukta_hi: Unknown unicast → flood। Known unicast → एक port। Broadcast FF:FF:... → flood। Source MAC → CAM में learn/refresh।

subtopic: Section B — Switch / NIC / Bridge
stem_en: A router is connected between two switches. If a broadcast frame is sent on Switch-A, what will Switch-B receive?
stem_hi: दो switches के बीच एक router जुड़ा है। यदि Switch-A पर broadcast frame भेजा जाए, तो Switch-B क्या प्राप्त करेगा?
explanation_en: Routers do not forward broadcast traffic — each side of the router is a separate broadcast domain, so Switch-B receives nothing.
explanation_hi: Router broadcast traffic को आगे नहीं भेजते — router के दोनों ओर अलग broadcast domains होते हैं, इसलिए Switch-B कुछ भी प्राप्त नहीं करेगा।
nukta_en: Router = broadcast firewall. This is why routers split broadcast domains and switches don't.
nukta_hi: Router = broadcast firewall। इसीलिए router broadcast domains तोड़ते हैं और switches नहीं।

subtopic: Section B — Switch / NIC / Bridge
stem_en: A switch has 4 VLANs configured. How many broadcast domains exist?
stem_hi: एक switch पर 4 VLANs configure हैं। कितने broadcast domains होंगे?
explanation_en: Each VLAN is its own broadcast domain — 4 VLANs = 4 broadcast domains on that switch.
explanation_hi: हर VLAN अपना अलग broadcast domain है — उस switch पर 4 VLANs = 4 broadcast domains।
nukta_en: VLAN = virtual switch = its own broadcast domain. Inter-VLAN communication needs a router (or L3 switch).
nukta_hi: VLAN = virtual switch = अपना broadcast domain। Inter-VLAN संचार के लिए router (या L3 switch) चाहिए।

subtopic: Section B — Switch / NIC / Bridge
stem_en: In a router-on-a-stick setup with VLANs, which device handles VLAN tagging and which handles inter-VLAN routing?
stem_hi: VLANs वाले router-on-a-stick setup में VLAN tagging कौन करता है और inter-VLAN routing कौन?

options.text_en: Both switch and router do VLAN tagging
options.text_hi: Both switch and router do VLAN tagging

explanation_en: The switch carries VLAN-tagged (802.1Q) frames on the trunk, and the router (sub-interfaces) routes between the VLANs.
explanation_hi: Switch trunk पर VLAN-tagged (802.1Q) frames ले जाता है, और router (sub-interfaces) VLANs के बीच routing करता है।
nukta_en: 802.1Q tagging = switch trunk job. Inter-VLAN routing = router (router-on-a-stick) or L3 switch.
nukta_hi: 802.1Q tagging = switch trunk का काम। Inter-VLAN routing = router (router-on-a-stick) या L3 switch।

subtopic: Section B — Switch / NIC / Bridge
stem_en: A packet travels: wired PC → Switch → Access Point → Wireless laptop. Which devices operate at Layer 2 only?
stem_hi: एक packet यात्रा करता है: wired PC → Switch → Access Point → Wireless laptop। कौन-से devices केवल Layer 2 पर काम करते हैं?
explanation_en: A switch is a Layer-2 device and an access point acts as a wireless bridge — also Layer-2 (it bridges 802.3 frames to 802.11 frames).
explanation_hi: Switch एक Layer-2 device है और access point एक wireless bridge की तरह काम करता है — वह भी Layer-2 (यह 802.3 frames को 802.11 frames में बदलता है)।
nukta_en: AP = wireless bridge (L2). Switch = L2. Router = L3. WAPs don't route unless configured as routers.
nukta_hi: AP = wireless bridge (L2)। Switch = L2। Router = L3। WAPs routing नहीं करते (जब तक router mode में न हों)।

subtopic: Section B — Switch / NIC / Bridge
stem_en: What does a MAC address represent?
stem_hi: MAC address किसका प्रतिनिधित्व करता है?

options.text_en: The location of the device in the network
options.text_hi: The location of the device in the network

options.text_en: The unique identity of the NIC
options.text_hi: The unique identity of the NIC

explanation_en: The MAC address is the unique hardware identity of the NIC (Network Interface Card) — burned in by the manufacturer.
explanation_hi: MAC address, NIC (Network Interface Card) की unique hardware पहचान है — manufacturer द्वारा burn की गई।
nukta_en: MAC = NIC identity (who). IP = location in network (where). Routing path = router's job.
nukta_hi: MAC = NIC identity (कौन)। IP = network में स्थान (कहाँ)। Routing path = router का काम।

subtopic: Section B — Switch / NIC / Bridge
stem_en: Which of the following component is responsible for network communication in a computer system?
stem_hi: कंप्यूटर सिस्टम में network communication के लिए कौन-सा component ज़िम्मेदार होता है?
explanation_en: Ethernet card यानी NIC (Network Interface Card) ही computer को network से जोड़ता है और frames भेजने-पाने का काम करता है.
explanation_hi: Ethernet card यानी NIC (Network Interface Card) ही computer को network से जोड़ता है और frames भेजने-पाने का काम करता है.
nukta_en: NIC = computer का network वाला हाथ — इसी पर MAC address बसा होता है.
nukta_hi: NIC = computer का network वाला हाथ — इसी पर MAC address बसा होता है.

subtopic: Section B — Switch / NIC / Bridge
stem_en: LANs can be connected by which of the following devices that operate on the data link layer?
stem_hi: LANs को data link layer पर काम करने वाले निम्न में से किस device से जोड़ा जा सकता है?
explanation_en: Bridges LANs को data link layer (Layer 2) पर जोड़ते हैं और MAC addresses देखकर frames आगे भेजते हैं.
explanation_hi: Bridges LANs को data link layer (Layer 2) पर जोड़ते हैं और MAC addresses देखकर frames आगे भेजते हैं.
nukta_en: Hub = L1, Bridge/Switch = L2, Router = L3, Gateway = L4+.
nukta_hi: Hub = L1, Bridge/Switch = L2, Router = L3, Gateway = L4+.

subtopic: Section C — Router / Brouter
stem_en: Which hardware forwards data packets between computer networks?
stem_hi: कौन-सा hardware computer networks के बीच data packets को आगे भेजता है?
explanation_en: A router forwards packets between DIFFERENT networks using the routing information (IP addresses) in the packet.
explanation_hi: Router packet के भीतर routing information (IP addresses) का उपयोग करके विभिन्न networks के बीच packets को आगे भेजता है।
nukta_en: Official KVS key. Router = between networks (L3). Switch = within a network (L2). Cable = medium. Nibble = 4 bits!
nukta_hi: Official KVS key। Router = networks के बीच (L3)। Switch = network के भीतर (L2)। Cable = medium। Nibble = 4 bits!

subtopic: Section C — Router / Brouter
stem_en: Which device operates at Layer 3 of the OSI model?
stem_hi: OSI model की Layer 3 पर कौन-सा device काम करता है?
explanation_en: The router works at the Network layer (Layer 3) — it forwards packets using logical IP addresses and routing tables.
explanation_hi: Router Network layer (Layer 3) पर काम करता है — यह logical IP addresses और routing tables का उपयोग करके packets भेजता है।
nukta_en: Device-layer ladder: Repeater/Hub 1, Switch/Bridge/NIC 2, Router 3, Gateway 7.
nukta_hi: Device-layer ladder: Repeater/Hub 1, Switch/Bridge/NIC 2, Router 3, Gateway 7।

subtopic: Section C — Router / Brouter
stem_en: Among these network devices — i. Repeater  ii. Hub  iii. Switch  iv. Router — which are considered intelligent devices?
stem_hi: इन network devices में — i. Repeater  ii. Hub  iii. Switch  iv. Router — कौन-से intelligent devices माने जाते हैं?
explanation_en: Switch and router are intelligent — they read addresses (MAC/IP) and make forwarding decisions; repeater and hub blindly repeat/forward signals.
explanation_hi: Switch और router intelligent हैं — ये addresses (MAC/IP) पढ़कर forwarding decisions लेते हैं; repeater और hub अंधों की तरह signals दोहराते/भेजते हैं।
nukta_en: Intelligent = reads addresses + filters/forwards selectively (switch, router, bridge, gateway). Dumb = hub, repeater.
nukta_hi: Intelligent = addresses पढ़ता है + selectively filter/forward करता है (switch, router, bridge, gateway)। Dumb = hub, repeater।

subtopic: Section C — Router / Brouter
stem_en: A router performs which of the following? (1) Packet forwarding  (2) Logical addressing  (3) Collision detection  (4) Routing decision
stem_hi: Router निम्न में से कौन-सा कार्य करता है? (1) Packet forwarding  (2) Logical addressing  (3) Collision detection  (4) Routing decision
explanation_en: A router forwards packets, uses logical (IP) addressing and makes routing decisions — but collision detection is a Layer-2 (CSMA/CD) function, not a router's.
explanation_hi: Router packets भेजता है, logical (IP) addressing उपयोग करता है और routing decisions लेता है — लेकिन collision detection Layer-2 (CSMA/CD) का काम है, router का नहीं।
nukta_en: Router = forward + route + logical addressing. NOT collision detection (that's Ethernet L2 on switches/NICs).
nukta_hi: Router = forward + route + logical addressing। Collision detection नहीं (वह switches/NICs पर Ethernet L2 का काम है)।

subtopic: Section C — Router / Brouter
stem_en: Consider: S1: The TTL field decreases at each router. S2: The MAC address changes at each hop. Which is correct?
stem_hi: देखिए: S1: TTL field हर router पर घटती है। S2: MAC address हर hop पर बदलता है। कौन-सा सही है?
explanation_en: At every router hop the TTL is decremented (and header checksum recomputed) AND a new frame with new source/destination MAC addresses is built. Both statements are true.
explanation_hi: हर router hop पर TTL घटती है (और header checksum फिर से बनता है) और नए source/destination MAC addresses वाला नया frame बनता है। दोनों कथन सही हैं।
nukta_en: Per-hop changes: TTL↓ + MAC rewritten. End-to-end: IP addresses unchanged (except NAT).
nukta_hi: Per-hop बदलाव: TTL↓ + MAC फिर से लिखा जाता है। End-to-end: IP addresses अपरिवर्तित (NAP को छोड़कर)।

subtopic: Section C — Router / Brouter
stem_en: A router drops some packets deliberately due to congestion. What is this technique called?
stem_hi: Router congestion के कारण कुछ packets जानबूझकर छोड़ देता है। इस तकनीक को क्या कहते हैं?
explanation_en: Random Early Detection (RED) proactively drops (or marks) packets before the queue is full, signalling senders to slow down — a congestion-avoidance technique.
explanation_hi: Random Early Detection (RED) queue भरने से पहले ही packets छोड़ (या mark) देता है, जिससे senders धीमे हो जाएँ — यह एक congestion-avoidance तकनीक है।
nukta_en: Congestion tools: RED (early random drops), Queuing (FIFO/PQ), Traffic shaping. Dropping ALL at overflow = tail drop.
nukta_hi: Congestion tools: RED (early random drops), Queuing (FIFO/PQ), Traffic shaping। Overflow पर सब छोड़ना = tail drop।

subtopic: Section C — Router / Brouter
stem_en: Which device creates a separate broadcast domain?
stem_hi: कौन-सा device अलग broadcast domain बनाता है?
explanation_en: Each router interface belongs to a different broadcast domain — the router is the boundary between them.
explanation_hi: हर router interface अलग broadcast domain से संबंधित होता है — router उनके बीच की सीमा है।
nukta_en: Broadcast domain boundary = router (or VLAN). Collision domain boundary = switch port/bridge.
nukta_hi: Broadcast domain सीमा = router (या VLAN)। Collision domain सीमा = switch port/bridge।

subtopic: Section D — Gateway, Firewall & NAT Devices
stem_en: If two systems use DIFFERENT protocols, which device is used to link them?
stem_hi: यदि दो systems भिन्न protocols उपयोग करते हैं, तो उन्हें जोड़ने के लिए कौन-सा device उपयोग होता है?
explanation_en: A gateway is a protocol converter — it translates between different protocols/architectures so dissimilar systems can communicate.
explanation_hi: Gateway एक protocol converter है — यह विभिन्न protocols/architectures के बीच अनुवाद करता है ताकि भिन्न systems संवाद कर सकें।
nukta_en: Gateway = protocol converter (L7). Bridge = similar LANs, same protocols (L2). Repeater/Hub = signal level (L1).
nukta_hi: Gateway = protocol converter (L7)। Bridge = समान LANs, समान protocols (L2)। Repeater/Hub = signal level (L1)।

subtopic: Section D — Gateway, Firewall & NAT Devices
stem_en: Which device can operate across all 7 layers of the OSI model?
stem_hi: कौन-सा device OSI model की सभी 7 layers पर काम कर सकता है?
explanation_en: A gateway (protocol converter) works at the application layer and may involve all layers to translate between different protocol stacks.
explanation_hi: Gateway (protocol converter) application layer पर काम करता है और भिन्न protocol stacks के बीच अनुवाद के लिए सभी layers को शामिल कर सकता है।
nukta_en: Gateway = 'all 7 layers' device. Hub 1, switch/bridge 2, router 3 — exam one-liner.
nukta_hi: Gateway = 'सभी 7 layers' वाला device। Hub 1, switch/bridge 2, router 3 — exam one-liner।

subtopic: Section D — Gateway, Firewall & NAT Devices
stem_en: Devices on one network can communicate with devices on another network via:
stem_hi: एक network के devices दूसरे network के devices से किसके माध्यम से संवाद कर सकते हैं?
explanation_en: A gateway connects different networks (often with different protocols) and lets their devices communicate — the entry/exit point between networks.
explanation_hi: Gateway विभिन्न networks (अक्सर भिन्न protocols वाले) को जोड़ता है और उनके devices को संवाद करने देता है — networks के बीच प्रवेश/निकास बिंदु।
nukta_en: Gateway = network-to-network doorway (also default gateway = router IP used to exit the LAN).
nukta_hi: Gateway = network-to-network दरवाज़ा (default gateway भी = LAN से बाहर निकलने के लिए router IP)।

subtopic: Section D — Gateway, Firewall & NAT Devices
stem_en: Which type of firewall inspects packets at the network layer and decides based on IP addresses?
stem_hi: कौन-सी firewall network layer पर packets की जाँच करके IP addresses के आधार पर निर्णय लेती है?
explanation_en: A packet-filtering firewall works at the network layer — it allows/denies packets by source/destination IP (and ports) using ACL rules.
explanation_hi: Packet-filtering firewall network layer पर काम करती है — यह ACL rules से source/destination IP (और ports) के आधार पर packets को allow/deny करती है।
nukta_en: Firewall types: Packet filtering (L3/L4, stateless) → Stateful (tracks sessions) → Proxy/Application gateway (L7) → Circuit-level gateway (L5).
nukta_hi: Firewall types: Packet filtering (L3/L4, stateless) → Stateful (sessions याद रखती है) → Proxy/Application gateway (L7) → Circuit-level gateway (L5)।

subtopic: Section D — Gateway, Firewall & NAT Devices
stem_en: Which firewall acts as an intermediary between the client and server at the application layer?
stem_hi: कौन-सी firewall application layer पर client और server के बीच मध्यस्थ (intermediary) के रूप में काम करती है?
explanation_en: A proxy (application) firewall terminates the client connection and opens a separate connection to the server — hiding the internal client completely.
explanation_hi: Proxy (application) firewall client connection समाप्त करके server के लिए अलग connection खोलती है — internal client को पूरी तरह छिपाती है।
nukta_en: Proxy = L7 intermediary (deep inspection, hides internals). Circuit gateway = L5 (session/relay).
nukta_hi: Proxy = L7 intermediary (गहरी जाँच, internals छिपाती है)। Circuit gateway = L5 (session/relay)।

subtopic: Section D — Gateway, Firewall & NAT Devices
stem_en: What is the role of a firewall in computer networks?
stem_hi: Computer networks में firewall की भूमिका क्या है?
explanation_en: A firewall monitors and filters incoming/outgoing traffic according to security rules — protecting the trusted network from unauthorised access.
explanation_hi: Firewall security rules के अनुसार आने-जाने वाले traffic की निगरानी और छँटनी करता है — trusted network को unauthorised access से बचाता है।
nukta_en: Firewall = traffic filter between trusted & untrusted networks (screening router, DMZ...). DHCP = IP management; DNS = names.
nukta_hi: Firewall = trusted और untrusted networks के बीच traffic filter (screening router, DMZ...)। DHCP = IP management; DNS = names।

subtopic: Section D — Gateway, Firewall & NAT Devices
stem_en: What is the purpose of a proxy server in networking?
stem_hi: Networking में proxy server का उद्देश्य क्या है?
explanation_en: A proxy server sits between clients and the internet — it filters requests (policy, caching) and forwards them, hiding the client's identity.
explanation_hi: Proxy server clients और internet के बीच बैठता है — यह requests को filter (policy, caching) करके आगे भेजता है, client की पहचान छिपाता है।
nukta_en: Proxy = filter + forward + cache + hide client. Firewall = block/allow by rules. Both are security/traffic devices.
nukta_hi: Proxy = filter + forward + cache + client छिपाना। Firewall = rules से block/allow। दोनों security/traffic devices हैं।

subtopic: Section D — Gateway, Firewall & NAT Devices
stem_en: Which is a network security system designed to protect a trusted private network from an untrusted outside network to which it is connected?
stem_hi: कौन-सी network security system trusted private network को उस जुड़े हुए untrusted outside network से बचाने के लिए बनी है?
explanation_en: A firewall is the security system placed between a trusted internal network and an untrusted external network (like the Internet).
explanation_hi: Firewall एक security system है जो trusted internal network और untrusted external network (जैसे Internet) के बीच लगाया जाता है।
nukta_en: Rajasthan PYQ (verified key: C) — the classic firewall definition. Compare: bridge = L2 link, cookie = web state, SSL = encryption.
nukta_hi: Rajasthan PYQ (verified key: C) — firewall की classic परिभाषा। तुलना: bridge = L2 link, cookie = web state, SSL = encryption।

subtopic: Section D — Gateway, Firewall & NAT Devices
stem_en: What kind of NAT maps one private IP to exactly one public IP?
stem_hi: किस प्रकार का NAT एक private IP को ठीक एक public IP से जोड़ता है?
explanation_en: Static NAT creates a permanent one-to-one mapping between a private and a public IP address (used for servers).
explanation_hi: Static NAT एक private और एक public IP address के बीच स्थायी one-to-one mapping बनाता है (servers के लिए उपयोग)।
nukta_en: NAT types: Static = 1↔1 permanent. Dynamic = pool mapping. PAT/NAT-overload = many↔1 using ports.
nukta_hi: NAT types: Static = 1↔1 स्थायी। Dynamic = pool mapping। PAT/NAT-overload = ports से many↔1।
